summary: PicksZone backend E2E suite - 24/24 tests passed on public URL. Covered auth (register/login/me/language/duplicate), public content (predictions/markets/banners/payment-methods/ranking), public PM NOT leaking config, push public-key, admin predictions/markets/payment-methods/banners CRUD, bet flow with won payout (1000->900->1090 verified), void-refund flow, settle authorization (403 for non-admin), recharge validation (amount $10 and $8000 rejected), recharge approve adds coins / reject no-op, duplicate-review blocked, admin users role/coins adjust, admin metrics shape, notifications send with no subscribers returns sent=0, and serialization check that no endpoint leaks Mongo _id.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 422 (Pydantic) instead of 400 when amount<20 or >7000. Functional but inconsistent with other 400 validation errors.
Pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs (.test, .local). Minor - clients should use real domains.

critical_code_review_comments: admin_set_role / admin_adjust_coins accept raw dict body - should use Pydantic models for validation consistency.
admin_adjust_coins does not check user exists nor prevent negative balance (delta -1000 on balance 0 would go negative). Consider adding guard.
Recharge min/max validated only via Pydantic Field (returns 422); consider explicit 400 with clear message to match other endpoints.

google_session stores Emergent session but does not check for duplicate session_token insert - unique index could cause 500 on retry (currently inserts new uuid session_id each time, relies on unique session_token).

CORS is configured with allow_credentials=True AND allow_origins=["*"] which browsers reject together. Works here because allow_origin_regex='.*' takes effect, but it is non-standard; recommend explicit origin list.
No rate limiting / brute force protection on /api/auth/login.
server.py is ~900 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, public, bets, admin) for maintainability.
serialize() is defined but inconsistently used (many endpoints strip _id via projection which is cleaner); document convention.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_ prefixed users/markets/banners/payment_methods created during run. Markets/banners/pms cleaned where possible; test users remain (documented).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use @example.com (NOT .test/.local) for Pydantic EmailStr. Cookies are sameSite=none+secure; requests.Session cookiejar works fine against public HTTPS URL. Market settle is idempotent-blocked (already-settled returns 400). void settle = empty winning_label refunds bets. Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_pickszone.py is reusable - run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_pickszone.py -v`.
rca of the issue: N/A - no functional bugs found. Initial 11 test errors/failures were due to test script using .test TLD which pydantic EmailStr rejects; fixed by using @example.com.
